name: Illiyana Moonblaze
summary: At Silverwing Grove, Illiyana Moonblaze supplies Alliance champions bound for the fight against the Warsong Outriders. She works beside the Silverwing Sentinels in Ashenvale.

sections.title: Silverwing Supply Officer
sections.body: At Silverwing Grove, Illiyana Moonblaze keeps the Silverwing Sentinels supplied. Her post lies near the path into Warsong Gulch. From there, she outfits defenders holding Ashenvale's southern woods against the Warsong clan.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front Lines
sections.body: Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to fight the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she provides custom rations, specialized draughts, and fine weapons for woodland skirmishes. Weary fighters return from the front for repairs to their weapons and armor, keeping the Sentinels ready for war.

faq.q: Where can I find Illiyana Moonblaze?
faq.answer: You can find Illiyana Moonblaze at Silverwing Grove in southeastern Ashenvale. She is near the staging grounds and portal leading into Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Is Illiyana Moonblaze a member of the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze works alongside the Silverwing Sentinels as their supply officer. She outfits Alliance champions fighting beside them.

faq.q: What does Illiyana offer to Alliance champions?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze offers care packages, battlefield weapons, armor, rings, tabards, and consumables to champions who gain favor with the Silverwing Sentinels.
Yes. Illiyana Moonblaze repairs weapons and armor for Alliance defenders resting at the grove. She also supplies specialized military gear.

faq.q: What care packages does she hand out?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze gives Alliance fighters Sentinel Basic, Standard, and Advanced Care Packages. Her supplies provide frontline defenders with essential battlefield provisions.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter marching south toward the contested border of Warsong Gulch, you can look to Illiyana Moonblaze for weapons, armor, and rations.
As a night elf, you can see Illiyana Moonblaze keeping the Silverwing Sentinels supplied as the kaldorei rally to safeguard Ashenvale.
